text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Hishi Amazon was truly something
else. Her
running today was quite
excellent.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
She's suddenly given us something to
look
forward to come next year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's jaw-dropping
performance
creates a stir among the
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not too shabby, if I do say so
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as I'm about to suggest she gets
some
hard-earned rest, a voice cuts into
our
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What are you guys doin' all the way
here?

text_block_list.name: Miho Student B
text_block_list.text:
We overheard people talking about you
in the
stands! Everyone's saying you'll be
the biggest
racer next year!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student B
text_block_list.text:
We got so excited, we just had to come
tell you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... So they've all got eyes on me,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the heads up! Guess this
means no
slackin' for me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! It's back to the academy for
some
training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna head out now, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon leaves the Hanshin
Racecourse with
her residents trailing
after her. I couldn't get a
word in to stop
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the new year comes, Hishi Amazon
will
finally enter her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon, it'll be time for her to decide
whether she
wants to pursue the Triple
Tiara tour or the
Classic Triple Crown
tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In my opinion, the Tiara tour is better
suited for
her, considering her aptitude
for mile and
medium-distance races.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll ask her to start considering her
options, but
for now, I'll focus our
training plans on the first
Tiara race, the
Oka Sho.
